messages:
Laila Singh: Hi all! Laila here (she/her). First day on Eng Infra — thrilled to be here. I9m in Portland but heading to the SF office this afternoon. Quick intro: I9m into slow coffee, terrible puns, and experimental sourdough that occasionally rises and sometimes doesn9t. Also, my favorite mug is white with tiny navy polka dots and a small chip on the rim 9— if anyone sees it wandering the kitchen, it9s mine. Who handles lost mugs around here? :wave: :coffee:

welcome-bot: Welcome to Redwood Inference, Laila! Check #help for badge pickup hours. You9ll also get a welcome email with onboarding links and the new-hires lunch invite. :tada:

Avery Chen: Hey Laila, welcome! I9m on-site Mon/Wed/Fri. Mugs often get left on the bench or in rooms. If you9re at the office today, swing by reception and I9ll walk you to the badge station. Also, we have a small musician cluster 9— do you play anything?

Laila Singh: Thanks, Avery! I play uke and occasionally attempt bass. Low commitment. :) I9ll be in around 2pm and would love a quick tour.

Maya Chen: Welcome!!! Polka-dot mugs are my kryptonite. If it9s not on the shelf, check the drying rack or the little conference room by marketing. Also there9s a casual lunch meet at 12:30 near the espresso machine if you want to meet folks.

Sam Pizza: Yo Laila 9— welcome to the chaos. If you9re worried about mug theft, label it with a sticker or shove it in a drawer like a civilized person. I have a label maker in Drawer B that I will gladly loan you. Also, tell us your snack preferences for the welcome pack (sweet/savory/vegan?).

Rory Patel: Badge process at reception is quick. Say you9re with Eng Infra and they9ll give you a temp badge. Ping me after you9re scanned and I9ll add you to the office wifi and printer groups.

Facilities: Hello Laila 9— Facilities here. We maintain a small lost-and-found near Mail Room 1. If you describe the mug (white with navy dots, chip on rim), we9ll check and leave it at reception if found. Also, if you notice any fridge items unlabelled, please tag them or we9ll clear at EOD on Fridays.

Laila Singh: Polka-dot confirmed: white base, navy dots, chip near handle. Thank you Facilities 9— I9ll check the mail room and then reception. Snack prefs: tea > coffee, but I9m not picky. Happy to bring a jar of sourdough starters for those who want to look at fermented chaos. :bread:

Avery Chen: I think I saw that mug in Conf Blue yesterday during a pairing session. If nobody scoops it by 1:45 I9ll rescue it and put it on your desk. Also, meet by the espresso machine at 12:27 if you want to join the lunch crowd.

Sam Pizza: Adding note: we put a tiny welcome snack at new desks. If you have dietary restrictions, DM me. Otherwise expect cookies or trail mix depending on the chef9s mood. :cookie:

Laila Singh: Amazing, thank you all. Desk rescue would make my day. See you later 9— excited to dive in and meet the team. :smile: 

welcome-bot: Badge hours reminder: Mon-Fri 9:00-17:00. For any access issues, file a ticket in #help.

Facilities: Update: We found a white mug with navy dots in Mail Room 1. It will be placed at reception under "Laila Singh" after 11:00.

Laila Singh: You are a saint, Facilities. I owe you a sourdough sacrifice. See you all soon!
